Posso aprire un conto senza la residenza: Can I open an account without being resident in Italy?
Sì, ma dipende dalla banca. I conti onli: Yes, but it depends on the bank. Online accounts like HYPE, N26 and Revolut often accept you without Italian residence, provided you have valid ID and a phone number. Traditional banks usually require certified residence (a residence certificate or an Italian ID card).
Serve lo SPID per aprire un conto?: Do I need SPID to open an account?
No, lo SPID non è obbligatorio per aprir: No, SPID is not required to open an account. Some banks accept it as an online identification method instead of the selfie or video check, but you can always open the account in a branch with physical documents.
